FollowupD633.native_weighted_convolution_triangular.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [MeasureTheory.IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  [MeasureTheory.SFinite mu] [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (z : ℂ) (a s alpha : ℝ)
  (m : ℕ) (h f : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h) (hs : HasCompactSupport h)
  (hg : ∀ k ≤ m, MeasureTheory.MemLp (SpectralRound9B.genuineNormalizedMellinJet K chi z a s alpha k) 2 mu)
  (hf :
    MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x => ↑(SpectralRound11B.nativeHalfWeight alpha s (Round166F.classLog K x)) * f x) 2 mu) :
  ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
      (∫ (g : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), h g * f (g⁻¹ * x) ∂mu) *
        SpectralRound11B.genuineMellinJet K chi z a m x ∂mu =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      (∫ (g : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), h g * SpectralRound11B.genuineMellinJet K chi z a k g ∂mu) *
          ↑(m.choose k) *
        ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), SpectralRound11B.genuineMellinJet K chi z a (m - k) y * f y ∂mu
